method: Manual source-aware labeling of the fixed six-call comparison plus the explicitly post hoc two-call deletion control. core_hit means the answer explicitly says nature/natural beauty; it is not a full factuality judgment.
observations: Existing-memory arm says nature in both calls, but its Nate memory says nature brings inspiration rather than directly preserving D28:23's appreciation of beauty; a matching answer is not proof that the prompt contains both source relations.
Source-turn arm names both speakers and their nature-beauty relation in one of two calls; the other call gives only the correct short answer.
Base and drop-only arms focus on self-care or Little Women instead. No call adds another nature-like common answer on top of the gold answer.
Manual labels are one-case observations; removal, insertion, prompt length, and generation variability are not fully isolated.
